The '''CFLA''' is the [[FLLA]]-affiliated continental football confederation for [[Acrola]]. It was allocated 5 berths at the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]], at which it was represented by [[Terressin]], [[Pelines]], [[Acetoa]], [[Viussi]] and [[Jshain]].
